There are plenty of innovative teaching methods that don't involve VR! You could try gamification, where you turn math concepts into competitive games or challenges. Another option is project-based learning, where students apply math to real-world scenarios. Flipped classrooms, where students watch instructional videos at home and do problem-solving in class, can also be effective. Interactive whiteboards or tablet-based activities can add a tech element without the disorientation. Which of these methods do you think would work best with your teaching style?
